enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed in Bedroom 1. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn onto the left side. Bend the knees. Keep breathing slowly. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Slide the hand under the pillow. Shift the pillow. Turn onto the back. Stretch both legs out. Roll onto the left side again. Pull the blanket down to the chest. Sleep continuously with eyes closed.

Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing both legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Press the light switch to turn on the Light. Press the switch to turn on the WaterHeater. Press the switch to turn on the Fan. Turn on the tap. Rinse both hands under the water. Step into the shower area. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms, chest and legs. Rinse off the soap. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Turn off the Light. Turn off the Fan. Push the door open. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Say "Good morning" to Member 2. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Take out the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread on the counter. Put two slices of bread into the Toaster. Press the Toaster lever down. Take a bowl from the cabinet. Pour cereal into the bowl. Pour milk into the bowl. Pick up a spoon from the drawer. Sit down on the chair at the table. Pick up the spoon. Eat the cereal with the spoon. Pick up the toast from the Toaster. Spread butter on the toast with a knife. Eat the toast. Drink the milk from the glass. Stand up. Carry the bowl and the glass to the sink. Place them in the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the bowl. Turn off the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt. Take out a pair of trousers. Lay the shirt and trousers on the bed. Take off the pajama top. Take off the pajama bottoms. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Tuck the shirt into the trousers. Put on the trousers. Zip up the trousers. Fasten the belt. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie the shoelaces. Walk to the mirror. Comb the hair. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Put the phone into the trouser pocket. Close the wardrobe door. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing schedule and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk back into Bedroom 1. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the desk. Press the DeskLamp switch to turn on the DeskLamp. Press the power button on the Computer. Wait for the screen to load. Type the password on the keyboard. Click the mouse to open the calendar. Read the day's schedule on the screen. Open the notebook. Pick up the pen. Write down the meeting times in the notebook. Pick up the phone. Swipe the phone screen. Read the message list. Put the phone down on the desk. Close the notebook. Put the notebook into the bag. Press the DeskLamp switch to turn off the DeskLamp. Shut down the Computer. Stand up. Pick up the bag. Push the chair under the desk. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

Walk to the front door. Open the door. Step outside. Close the door. Lock the door with the key. Walk down the stairs. Push the building entrance door open. Walk along the sidewalk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step forward as the bus arrives. Board the bus. Tap the card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Grab the handrail. Sit down on an empty seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Look at the phone screen again. Stand up as the bus approaches the stop. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk to the office building. Push the office building door open. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the office desk.

Sit down at the desk. Press the power button on the office computer. Type the password on the keyboard. Open the email program. Read the new emails. Type replies on the keyboard. Click the mouse to open the shared calendar. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down at the meeting table. Open the laptop. Take notes in the notebook with a pen during the team meeting. Speak about the community program schedule. Stand up. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Pick up the phone. Dial a community partner's number. Speak about the volunteer roster. End the call. Put the phone down. Type the volunteer list on the keyboard. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed pages. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Staple the pages together. Place the pages into the folder.

Stand up from the desk. Push the chair in. Walk to the office kitchen area. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lunch box. Close the refrigerator door. Open the Microwave door. Place the lunch box inside the Microwave. Close the Microwave door. Press the start button on the Microwave. Wait beside the Microwave. Open the Microwave door when it beeps. Take out the lunch box. Walk to the table. Sit down on the chair. Open the lunch box lid. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice and vegetables with the fork. Pick up the water bottle. Twist the cap open. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Put the water bottle down. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Stand up. Carry the lunch box to the sink. Rinse the lunch box. Turn off the tap. Throw the napkin into the bin. Walk back to the desk.

Sit down at the desk. Click the mouse to open the spreadsheet. Type the program budget numbers on the keyboard. Pick up the phone. Check the message list. Put the phone down. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down. Open the laptop. Discuss the community event plan with colleagues. Write action items in the notebook. Stand up. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Type the event checklist on the keyboard. Click the mouse to send the email. Stand up. Walk to the file cabinet. Pull the drawer open. Place the folder in the drawer. Push the drawer closed. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Read the printed documents. Mark the pages with a pen. Stack the documents on the desk.

Stand up from the desk. Pick up the bag. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the elevator. Push the office building door open. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Board the bus. Tap the card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Grab the handrail. Sit down on an empty seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Stand up as the bus approaches the stop. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk to the apartment building. Push the entrance door open. Walk up the stairs. Take out the key. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the front door open. Step inside. Close the door. Lock the door with the key.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Take off the shoes at the entrance. Hang the bag on the hook. Walk to the kitchen. Say "I'm home" to Member 2. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the meat. Close the refrigerator door. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Turn on the tap. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces on the cutting board. Place the pieces into a bowl. Press the switch to turn on the InductionCooker. Pour oil into the pan. Put the vegetables into the pan. Stir the vegetables with a spatula. Add salt with a spoon. Press the switch to turn on the RangeHood. Put the cooked dish onto a plate. Carry the plates to the table. Place the bowls and chopsticks on the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Eat dinner with Member 2. Pick up the chopsticks. Pick up the bowl. Drink the soup. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plates. Place the plates into the Dishwasher. Press the switch to turn off the InductionCooker.

Walk to the Living Room. Pick up the TV remote from the table. Press the power button on the TV. Sit down on the sofa next to Member 2. Press the channel button on the remote. Talk with Member 2 about the day. Pick up the AirConditioner remote. Press the power button to turn on the AirConditioner. Put the remote down on the sofa. Press the volume button on the TV remote. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Swipe the phone screen. Read the messages. Put the phone down on the sofa. Pick up the cup from the table. Drink water. Put the cup down. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Take an apple from the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the Living Room. Sit down on the sofa. Eat the apple. Press the power button on the TV remote to turn the TV off.

Stand up from the sofa. Say good night to Member 2. Walk to Bedroom 1. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the desk. Press the DeskLamp switch to turn on the DeskLamp. Press the switch to turn on the Fan. Press the power button on the Computer. Wait for the screen to load. Type the password on the keyboard. Click the mouse to open the browser. Scroll the web page with the mouse wheel. Type keywords on the keyboard. Click the mouse to open a video. Watch the video on the screen. Pick up the phone from the desk. Swipe the phone screen. Type a message on the phone. Put the phone down. Click the mouse to open the photo folder. Sort the photos into folders. Type a reply email on the keyboard. Click the mouse to send the email. Turn off the video player. Shut down the Computer. Press the DeskLamp switch to turn off the DeskLamp. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk.

Walk to the bed. Pick up the book from the nightstand. Sit down on the bed. Open the book to the bookmark. Read the pages. Turn a page with the right hand. Turn another page. Close the book. Place the book back on the nightstand. Stand up. Walk to the wardrobe. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the pajamas. Close the wardrobe door. Take off the shirt. Take off the trousers. Put on the pajama top. Put on the pajama bottoms. Fold the shirt and the trousers. Place them on the chair. Pull back the blanket on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Press the light switch to turn on the Light. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth with water. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Press the switch to turn off the Fan. Press the light switch to turn off the Light. Push the door open. Walk out of the bathroom. Say good night to Member 2.

Walk into Bedroom 1. Close the bedroom door. Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Turn onto the back. Stretch both legs out. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Keep breathing slowly. Turn onto the right side again. Pull the blanket to the chest. Remain lying down with eyes closed until the end of the time segment.
